SamenvattingStep into the world of logistics as a Order picker at Albert Heijn located next to Rotterdam. This is your chance to join a dynamic team, develop your skills, and enjoy real growth opportunities in a modern warehouse environment. Good work!Over de functieAs a Order picker at Albert Heijn Bleiswijk, you play a vital role in keeping the online orders running smoothly. Your daily routine includes picking orders with a handheld scanner, checking the quality of products, and managing stock levels. With the scanner, you’ll see exactly which item goes to which location, scan barcodes, and ensure every order is accurate. You’ll work in a modern warehouse, often in cool conditions to keep products fresh. The environment is lively, with team members supporting each other to get the job done. Your main responsibilities are:
- Picking online orders using a scanner
- Checking order quality before shipment
- Managing and organizing stock in the warehouse
- Following clear location and barcode systems
- Ensuring your work area remains clean and organized
- Collaborating with your team to meet daily targets

You’ll work in a 3-shift system: 
- mornings (06:00 – 14:30), 
- afternoons (14:30 – 23:00), 
- nights (23:00 – 06:00)

Over het bedrijfWithin this logistics company, you’ll be part of a well-organized and fast-paced warehouse team that makes sure customers get their groceries on time. Albert Heijn is a leading name in food retail in the Netherlands, known for reliability and efficiency. The warehouse in Bleiswijk serves a wide region, ensuring fresh products are picked and shipped daily. The team is diverse and supportive, with a practical, can-do attitude. Breaks include access to free fruit and a cafeteria, and new colleagues are guided by a buddy to help you settle in quickly.
Wat wij vragen- Own accomodation
- At least 1 year of experience as order picker or similar environments
- Able to communicate in English at a basic level
- Available to work also in
